scope: Audit of whether each G8 central-bank reaction-function labour channel can be tested honestly with the currently frozen PIT dataset. No revised-history substitution, no synthetic proxies, no parameter fitting.
dataset_rule: Only first-release/vintage PIT observations available at checkpoint may vote. Missing mediation variables are WITHHELD, not backfilled from revised history.

FED.reason: USD labour block is not PIT-eligible in the frozen minimum dataset.

ECB.required_labour_channel: labour -> wages -> services/domestic inflation -> ECB reaction
ECB.reason: Headline labour can be tested only as a diagnostic standalone block; the reaction-function-aware mediated path cannot yet be tested without PIT wages/services inflation.
ECB.interpretation: Do not conclude that Euro-area labour is economically useless. The available standalone labour test is structurally incomplete relative to the ECB reaction function.
next_required_data: Euro-area services/domestic inflation PIT release history

BOE.required_labour_channel: labour tightness -> wages -> services inflation -> BoE reaction
BOE.reason: ONS labour vintages are available, but the wage/services bridge required by the BoE reaction function is not yet in the frozen PIT dataset.

BOC.interpretation: CAD is currently the cleanest available example of a labour block whose direct policy relevance is compatible with the central-bank reaction function.

RBA.reason: Historical AUD PIT macro is withheld in the frozen minimum dataset despite live-source certification.

RBNZ.reason: Historical NZD PIT macro is withheld; no honest mediated-channel test is currently possible.

SNB.required_labour_channel: labour/economic activity -> inflation forecast -> SNB reaction
SNB.reason: Historical CHF PIT macro is withheld; live-source certification is not historical PIT evidence.

BOJ.required_labour_channel: labour tightness -> wages -> sustainable inflation -> BoJ reaction
BOJ.reason: JPY historical feasibility exists, but labour event-time policy remains unresolved and wages mediation is not yet frozen PIT.

key_conclusion: The ECB hypothesis cannot yet be accepted or rejected from the current PIT backtest. The weak EUR standalone Labour result is a valid diagnostic, but it is not a valid test of the ECB's labour-through-wages-and-services-inflation reaction channel.
priority_next_build: then rerun direct-labour versus mediated-labour OOS without changing frozen thresholds
guardrails: No changes to live data or engine rules
